title: This AI Tool Makes Claude Code 10X Smarter! #ai
description:
🚀 Want to make Claude Code and other AI coding assistants significantly more powerful?

In this video, you'll learn how Agent Reach allows AI coding assistants to access documentation directly from your terminal, eliminating constant browser switching and making AI-assisted development faster and more accurate.

Whether you're a software engineer, AI developer, full-stack developer, or someone experimenting with AI coding tools, this workflow can dramatically improve your productivity.
